channel.title: Mello TV Updates
channel.description: Updates for Mello TV on macOS.

item.description:
Mello TV 0.2.0 refreshes the Mac server app and adds household management and recovery tools.
- Redesigned Overview, Providers, and Network pages with silver titanium styling. - Manage profiles, playback defaults, tastes, and recommendations from the new Users page. - See active iPhone/iPad playback in Watching now and share server addresses with QR codes. - Run independent provider checks and see clearer results. - Create encrypted household backups, restore them on another Mac, and enable daily backups retaining seven files. - Improved server startup, crash recovery, shutdown, Settings, navigation, and Dock/menu-bar behavior. - Built-in catalog access without personal TMDB setup.
Keep your existing application data. This release also includes a new iOS IPA, browser-player improvements, and Docker hosting. See the GitHub release for the full notes.

item.title: Mello TV 0.1.0-alpha.3
item.description:
Mello TV 0.1.0-alpha.3 introduces in-app updates for macOS and corrects the Mac catalog status display.
- Signed updates: check from the Mello TV menu or Settings → Updates, with options for background checking and automatic updates. - Playback-aware installation: updates wait for active streaming to finish before restarting the Mac app and bundled server. A three-minute grace period bridges gaps between media requests; unavailable readiness checks postpone installation. - Catalog status: a working TMDB catalog now shows Available instead of Needs care.
Install the signed, notarized Apple Silicon macOS DMG by dragging Mello TV into Applications. Existing public Mac builds need this one manual installation to gain in-app updates. Keep your existing application data; profiles, viewing history, cached metadata, and Keychain credentials are preserved.
This is a Mac/server release. The iOS app is unchanged: continue using the alpha.2 IPA, which remains compatible and does not need reinstalling. [Download the unchanged iOS alpha.2 IPA](https://github.com/ChrisRodStar/Mello-Tv/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.2/Mello-TV-0.1.0-alpha.2-iOS.ipa).
Supported packaged platforms remain Apple Silicon Macs (macOS 13+) and the existing iOS client. Windows and Linux releases are not yet available. Provider availability and playback quality still depend on the source/title. Run an appropriate VPN on the server Mac.
